family_reports.body: Ex parte orders issued taking away parenting time/no contact. I had sole custody, also taken away with the appointment of a new GAL on the case for a few months. No evidence presented, no witnesses and Judge delays setting evidentiary hearing. I have always been the primary caregiver. Ex husband had been found guilty during a custody trial of emotional and verbal abuse. The system has failed me and my kids. GALs and case managers have too much power.

Naomi Cataudella’s involvement did not heal our family’s trauma — it prolonged and deepened it. Instead of helping rebuild trust and emotional safety, Naomi’s approach empowered an abuser, left our children feeling unheard, intensified family division, and reinforced a system where fear and dysfunction were repeatedly overlooked.
